title: Should I Go Outside? Weather-Based Activity Advisor
description: A production-ready web application that provides personalized outdoor activity recommendations based on real-time weather data, air quality, and calendar schedule. Features Flask API, Google Calendar integration, and AI-powered suggestions using local LLM (Ollama with Mistral 7B).

title: Gmail Automation Tool: AI-Powered Email Management
description: A Python-based Gmail automation tool that uses local LLMs via Ollama to intelligently summarize emails and generate automated reply drafts. Combines Gmail API with Mistral 7B for streamlined email management, content cleaning, and AI-powered productivity features.

title: Offline Wiki: RAG-Powered Knowledge Base
description: A fully offline Wikipedia/Wikivoyage search system with intelligent Q&A capabilities. Built with FAISS vector search, Sentence Transformers for embeddings, and Ollama for natural language generation. Access thousands of articles about European destinations without an internet connection.

title: Jonas: Your Personal Austrian German Tutor
description: Meet Jonas, a friendly AI chatbot designed to be your personal guide to Austrian German and culture. I built Jonas to be more than just a language app; he's a conversational partner who makes learning feel like chatting with a local. Using a fine-tuned language model and a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system I built with FAISS, Jonas can answer your questions about Austria, explain grammar in a simple way, and teach you everything from classic phrases to modern slang.

title: Song popularity predictor
description: Implemented linear regression to predict song popularity, created synthetic data

title: SIMCLR implementation on medical dataset
description: Self supervised learning implementation on medical dataset

title: Austrian Food Price Analysis & Email Automation
description: Analyzed Austrian food price indices (Producer Price Index vs Consumer Price Index) using Python (NumPy, Pandas).

title: Sales Report Automation
description: Raw data to insights: Automated sales report generation using Python (Pandas, Matplotlib) and email dispatch.

title: Malaria Cell Image Classification (CNN)
description: Classified malaria-infected vs healthy cells using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) in Python (TensorFlow, Keras).

title: Klinikum Report Editor
description: A comprehensive Flask web application for managing mental health report data with customizable fields, interactive graphs, and PDF export functionality.
